title: Approval authority (DOA)
intro: The DOA decides who approves which documents up to which amount. A published version never changes: a change is a new draft, edited on this screen or imported, and approved by the authority under the DOA, never by the person who sends it.
forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, contact your organization admin.
initialNotice: The organization has no DOA in effect yet. Import the first version and send it as the initial package, with the holders of its positions, for the contract signatory to approve.
empty: No DOA yet. Import the first version from a YAML file with the Import a new version from YAML form.
periodOpen: In effect from {from} until a new version
noReason: No reason for the change was recorded

lint.DOA_LINT_OVERLAP: {documentType}: amounts {band} fall under more than one rule
lint.DOA_LINT_MISSING_DOCTYPE: No rule for {documentType}. Every version needs a DOA-change rule and an authority-change rule.
lint.DOA_LINT_UNRESOLVABLE_GOVERNANCE: Rule {rule}: no approver can be found on the effective date, so nobody could approve policy changes
lint.DOA_LINT_PARALLEL_STEP: Rule {rule}: has a parallel approval step, which is not supported yet

import.title: Import a new version from YAML
import.intro: Use the same shape as the file each version downloads as. Each version needs a new version number. An imported version is a draft and takes no effect until it is sent and approved.
import.reasonHint: Kept in the version’s history and shown to the approver
import.openDraft: Open {name} to check and send it
import.problemsTitle: Nothing was imported. Fix the file as listed and import it again.

issues.NOT_YAML: This is not a readable YAML file. Check the indentation and the colons.
issues.UNKNOWN_MEMBER: No member of the organization has this code. Use the member’s employee code.
issues.DUPLICATE_RULE: This rule code is used by another rule of the same version

issues.INSTANT: Write the date and time with a time zone, e.g. "2026-11-01T00:00:00+07:00"
issues.EXTRA_KEY: Keys the system does not know: {keys}
issues.VALUE: The value is not one the system knows
issues.SHAPE: This does not follow the shape of a DOA file

initial.title: Send the organization’s initial package
initial.intro: The organization has no DOA yet, so the first version goes together with the holders of the positions it names, for the contract signatory to approve with an identity check.
initial.noSignatory: No contract signatory has been verified by the BCS team. Contact the BCS team before sending the initial package.
initial.youAreSignatory: You are the contract signatory, so you cannot send the package you approve. Ask another organization admin to send it.
initial.signatory: The package goes to {name} (the contract signatory) for approval
initial.holdersTitle: Holders of the positions this version names
initial.holdersHint: The list starts with the current holders. Only positions this version names may be listed, every current holder of them must be listed, one holder per position and department, and never yourself. Edit one row at a time.
initial.submit: Send the initial package to the contract signatory
initial.sent: Initial package sent. Waiting for {name} to approve.
initial.sentNoName: Initial package sent. Waiting for the contract signatory to approve.
initial.rowIncomplete: Choose the position, the department and the holder
initial.emptyRows: Nobody is in this package yet. Add the holders of the positions this version names with Add a position holder.
initial.missing: Positions this version names that are not in the list yet: {positions}
initial.finishEditing: Save or cancel the row you are editing before the next step
initial.next: Next: give the reason and send
initial.countLine: This initial package has {count, plural, one {# position holder} other {# position holders}} with this DOA version
initial.removedRow: {what} is taken out of the package

start.title: Edit the DOA on screen
start.intro: Start from a copy of the latest version, edit the amount bands, approvers, times under the SLA and policies as a table, and save it as a new draft. A draft takes no effect until it is sent and approved.

editor.pageIntro: Starts from a copy of {source} ({status}). Saving makes the draft {name}; {source} does not change. A draft takes no effect until it is sent and approved.
editor.rulesHint: Edit one rule at a time. The amount bands of each document type must join from 0 without gaps or overlaps; when you move a band edge, the band next to it moves along.

headers.approverSla: Approver and time under the SLA

editor.codeHint: Capital letters, digits, - or _, e.g. PR-04
editor.slaHint: A whole number from 1 to 999 business hours
editor.noRules: No rule for this document type yet. Add one with the button below.
editor.multiStep: This rule has {count} approval steps. This screen edits its amount band only; the steps stay as they are.
editor.followed: The bands next to it moved along: {list}
editor.notFollowed: Rule {rules} did not move along because its band would turn round. Edit or remove it before saving.
editor.removed: Rule {rule} is removed from the draft; this takes effect when the draft is saved

rowErrors.CODE: Use capital letters, digits, - or _ for the rule code, up to 40 characters
rowErrors.CODE_TAKEN: This rule code is in the version already. Use another code.
rowErrors.MONEY: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 30,000.00
rowErrors.BAND_ORDER: The upper end must be above the start of the band
rowErrors.SLA: Enter the business hours as a whole number from 1 to 999

editor.finishEditing: Save or cancel the rule you are editing before the next step
editor.policyHint: The policies apply to every rule of this version
editor.stepUpHint: From this amount the approver confirms their identity again. Leave empty for none.
editor.stepUpError: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, or leave it empty
editor.summaryNone: Nothing is edited yet: the draft will have the rules and policies of {name}, with its own effective date
editor.effectiveEcho: In effect from {time} (Thai time) once approved
editor.effectiveHint: Choose a date that has not come yet; the version takes effect at 00:00 that day once approved

dateErrors.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective date must not have come yet. Choose tomorrow or later.
dateErrors.LATER_VERSION_SCHEDULED: Version {version} is approved for the same or a later time. Choose a later date.

editor.saveHint: The whole version is checked (bands and approvers) before saving. {name} takes no effect until it is sent and approved. A saved draft cannot be deleted: {name} stays in the list of versions even if it is never sent, and the next edit gets a new number.
editor.saved: {name} saved as a draft. It takes no effect until it is sent and approved.
editor.openSaved: Open {name} to check and send it
editor.errorsTitle: Not saved: this version does not pass the checks. Fix what is listed and save again.

simulate.title: Try out {name}
simulate.intro: Enter a document type, amount, charged department and requester to see who the document goes to under the version in effect and under this version. The route is found the way a real document is routed, at this moment, with today’s position holders and delegates; nothing is saved.
simulate.netHint: Not needed for a DOA change or an authority change
simulate.vatHint: Leave empty when there is no VAT
simulate.departmentHint: The department that owns the budget; approvers are looked for from it upwards
simulate.requesterHint: When the approver found is the requester, the document moves to the next band as the version’s policy says

net.INVALID: Enter an amount in baht with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 25,000.00

fieldErrors.vat: Enter VAT in baht with at most 2 decimals, or leave it empty

simulate.empty: Enter the document and press Find the route to see who it goes to under each version
simulate.noInEffect: No version is in effect yet, so there is no route to compare with
simulate.isInEffect: This version is the one in effect, so both results are the same
simulate.same: Both versions send it to the same approvers: {names}
simulate.different: The results differ: the version in effect sends it to {before}, this version to {after}
simulate.differentError: The results differ: one version finds no route. See each version below.
simulate.escalated: Moved up from rule {rule} because its approver is the requester

routeErrors.DOA_NOT_CONFIGURED: No rule of this version applies to this document, so such a document cannot be sent
routeErrors.DOA_AMBIGUOUS: More than one rule applies equally ({rules}). Change their bands or ranks.
routeErrors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: Nobody holds {position} (looked in {departments}). Appoint a holder first.
routeErrors.NO_HIGHER_AUTHORITY: The approvers of this band and every band above are the requester: there is no higher authority
routeErrors.SOD_VIOLATION: The approver is the requester, and this version does not allow sending in that case
